summary: Iteration 3 - specs & bilingual descriptions. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASSED including 2 new iter-3 tests (test_seed_bikes_have_specs_and_description_en, test_admin_bike_crud_with_specs_and_description_en). GET /api/bikes returns the three new seeded bikes: Bianchi Arcadex GRX (gravel, €40, 5 specs incl. frame/groupset/brakes/wheels/weight), Specialized Turbo Creo 2 (egravel, €50, 8 specs incl. frame/motor/battery/range), Ghost E-Riot AM (ebike_mtb, €60, 9 specs incl. motor/battery/suspension/weight 24.5 kg). All three image_url load with HTTP 200 (Unsplash + Pexels). Each bike has non-empty description (IT) and description_en. POST/PUT /api/admin/bikes accepts and persists specs + description_en (verified via Create→GET and Update→GET). Admin bike form UI: has English description field (bike-form-description-en) and spec inputs for frame/motor/battery/range/suspension/groupset/brakes/wheels/weight (bike-form-spec-<key>) with correct localized labels (Telaio/Frame, Motore/Motor, etc.). Live edit test: changed Bianchi 'specs.frame' from 'Alluminio / Aluminium' to 'AlluminioEDIT / AluminiumEDIT' via UI → save toast 'Bici aggiornata' → GET /api/bikes confirms persistence → bike detail renders 'AlluminioEDIT' (IT half of the ' / ' pair). Bike detail (/bike/<id>) shows SPECIFICATIONS/Caratteristiche section (bike-specs) with per-key rows (bike-spec-frame, bike-spec-groupset, bike-spec-brakes, bike-spec-wheels, bike-spec-weight) and italian description. Switching Profile → language-en re-renders detail: description switches to description_en and spec values parse ' / ' correctly (frame: 'Aluminium', brakes: 'hydraulic disc'); switching back to language-it restores italian halves. specValue util in /app/frontend/src/format.ts correctly splits 'IT / EN' on ' / ' and picks the half for the active language; single-value specs (e.g. groupset 'Shimano GRX 2x11', wheels '700c, WTB Riddler 45 mm') render as-is in both languages. Regression: daily-only booking with 'Paga in negozio' still works end-to-end — size pick → book_now → /checkout → payment-method-store → confirm-booking-button → booking confirmed. BOTH confirm and payment buttons reachable (correct testIDs are 'payment-method-store' and 'confirm-booking-button'). Bianchi fully restored to original seed values (frame='Alluminio / Aluminium', full stock, image_url).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py SEED_BIKES uses the 'IT / EN' convention consistently for bilingual spec values (frame, brakes, range, suspension, wheels), while single-value specs omit the ' / ' separator — matches the specValue(v) split rule in frontend/src/format.ts.
Migration logic (startup) only backfills seeded bikes whose doc has no 'specs' field (specs: {$exists: false}), preserving any manually-edited bike. This is idempotent and safe across restarts.
Bike + BikeIn pydantic models now include specs: Dict[str,str] and description_en: str; admin_update_bike and admin_create_bike simply pass model_dump() so both fields persist by construction.
specValue only splits on ' / ' (space-slash-space) — defensive against pathological values; a 3+ parts value falls back to raw string (verified in /app/frontend/src/format.ts:72-76).
SPEC_KEYS order on both detail and admin-form uses the same tuple, so admin-side editing matches detail display order 1:1.
